Two weekly rotations with the same roster, `alerts` and `tickets` (alice, bob, carol, dave, `tolerance=0`), and a mutual `attract! alerts, tickets` row in `#Global`. `tickets` excludes carol for the week of 2026-10-19, the week `alerts` gives her. `alerts` is decided first by tab order and runs alice, bob, carol, dave, alice, bob. `tickets` follows it for the first two weeks; on 10-19 carol is excluded, so the plain pick falls to dave (lowest at 0). From 10-26 on the two rotations are out of step: the `alerts` holder (dave, then alice, then bob) stands at 7 in `tickets` while carol, never attracted, is lowest at 0, so plain `attract` would miss every week. `attract!` widens the band to the holder's score, 7 against 0, one shift length, since it is within `lowest + tolerance + 1ts` (0 + 0 + 28), and `tickets` runs dave, alice, bob in lockstep again; `expected/status.txt` lists the warning `tolerance widened to 1sl for attract! with alerts` at 10-26, 11-02 and 11-09, shows `+!` in the relations matrix, and the generated notes stay empty. Carol keeps the lowest score and will take the next `tickets` week that `alerts` gives her. Both ledgers get a `snapshot` row at 10-05 with every member at zero on this first run: the team rows dated at `S` apply before the snapshot (3.6).
